raw.title: EVgo Confirms Receipt of Unsolicited and Non-Binding Take Private Proposal
raw.text: LOS ANGELES, Nov. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- EVgo Inc. (“EVgo”) (NASDAQ: EVGO), one of the nation's largest providers of public fast charging infrastructure for electric vehicles, today announced that its Board of Directors (“Board”) received an unsolicited and non-binding proposal (“Proposal”) from LS Power Equity Advisors, LLC and certain of its affiliates (collectively, “LS Power”) to acquire all of the outstanding shares of EVgo's Class A common stock not currently owned by LS Power for cash consideration of $2.00 per share. LS Power currently holds approximately 56% of the combined voting power of EVgo's outstanding common stock. A copy of the Proposal is available as an exhibit to EVgo's Current Report on Form 8-K, which will be filed today with the Securities and Exchange Commission.

raw.text: INOVIO delivers a new nonsurgical treatment option with a broad indication for adults living with RRP, a rare and debilitating disease that often requires surgery VOCERYQ™ is a plasmid DNA-based immunotherapy that targets the root cause of RRP: HPV-6 and HPV-11 INOVIO expects to make VOCERYQ available to order and ship in approximately 60 days, with full commercial launch in the first quarter of 2027 VOCERYQ represents the first U.S. FDA approved DNA medicine, validating INOVIO's novel platform technology INOVIO will host a conference call Monday, November 2, 2026 at 8:00 AM ET PLYMOUTH MEETING, Pa., Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- INOVIO (NASDAQ: INO), a biotechnology company focused on developing and commercializing DNA medicines to help treat and protect people from HPV-related diseases, cancer, and infectious diseases, today announced that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has granted accelerated approval for VOCERYQ (doruxapapogene ralaplasmid and lalikinogene sifuplasmid-gxfd), previously referred to as INO-3107, to reduce the frequency of surgery in adults with RRP.

Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - October 28, 2026) - Searchlight Resources Inc. (TSXV: SCLT) (OTC Pink: SCLTF) ("Searchlight" or the "Company") is pleased to announce the completion of its high-resolution airborne magnetic survey over the Mari Lake Gold Project located approximately 30 kilometres north of Creighton, Saskatchewan and Flin Flon, Manitoba.
